players.prompt: Create ONE new full-body fantasy football sprite, genuinely transparent background. Use attached match-screen image as the MAIN reference for chunky small-pitch readability, proportions, deep shadows and bright highlights, NOT its UI. Redesign as slightly chibi adult athlete: approximately 3 heads tall, exaggerated large head and helmet, broad shoulders, big hands and feet, shortened limbs, compact powerful silhouette. Elevated three-quarter side-facing braced idle view toward screen right. Crisp retro game pixel-art, FEW LARGE clean connected color clusters, decisive almost-black 1-2 logical-pixel contour, deep near-black occlusion under chin/shoulder plates/between limbs, broad high-value highlights on top-left surfaces. Strong separation of limbs and torso. High contrast clearly readable at ONLY 64x64 pixels. Minimal micro-detail: no tiny rivet texture, scratches, mottling or soft gradients. Use 3-4 discrete values per material. Conceptually design on a 64x64 pixel grid and show a nearest-neighbor enlarged version if native output unavailable; no blurry anti-aliasing. Full figure centered with modest transparent margin, feet fully visible. No text, labels, UI, grass, floor, frame, extra views or other characters. Restrained tiny dark contact shadow directly between feet only if it helps grounding, no wide shadow. Human team palette: royal blue and warm ivory armor, navy shadows, bright ivory highlights, brown leather, gray steel. Subject: male ogre, enormous muscular bulk, broad underbite and tusks, bald scalp partly under blue helmet, heavy asymmetric blue and ivory shoulder armor, huge brown gauntlets, braced stance. Big ogre variant allowed 80x80, keep huge fists and head and chunky chibi stance.
